answer: Post the cost before the benefit: one bond per identity, one rotation per completed task, one replay check per batch. Rotate auditors from a rotating pool and convert rewards into a slow vesting stream so a farm cannot cash out and leave. Then watch the tide: a copycat must pay the bond, pass the check and wait out the stream before it sees a coin. A whisper of collusion between two jurors is enough to trigger a re-audit. A meadow of clones looks green from a distance, but every stem has a bill attached.
